sub: Log trees, team up and climb the board
name: Name
googleNote: Google shares only your name and email with Atmos X.
locationNote: Your location is only saved when you log an action.
deviceNote: Your account is kept on Atmos X servers, so it works on any device. Passwords are stored hashed.
presentationNote: Presentation mode is on, so you’re seeing Nadia’s demo account. Turn it off in Settings to use your own.

err.name: Tell your team what to call you (2+ letters).

auth.email_taken: There’s already an account with this email. Sign in instead.
auth.invalid_email: Enter a valid email, like you@example.com.
auth.name_required: Tell your team what to call you (2+ letters).
auth.insecure_context: Accounts need a secure connection (HTTPS or localhost). Open the app over HTTPS and try again.
